destination_translations.headline: El Caribe y la cultura wayuu
destination_translations.intro: Pasea junto al mar, conoce el centro de la capital guajira y descubre sus manglares y encuentros culturales.
destination_translations.meta_description: Descubre el muelle de Riohacha, la plaza de Padilla y el Valle de los Cangrejos. Conoce experiencias en Camarones y excursiones por La Guajira.

destination_translations.headline: The Caribbean and Wayuu culture
destination_translations.intro: Walk along the waterfront, explore La Guajira’s capital and discover its mangroves and cultural encounters.
destination_translations.meta_description: Discover Riohacha’s pier, Padilla Square and Valle de los Cangrejos. Explore experiences in Camarones and excursions through La Guajira.

destination_translations.headline: O Caribe e a cultura wayuu
destination_translations.intro: Passeie à beira-mar, conheça o centro da capital de La Guajira e descubra seus manguezais e encontros culturais.
destination_translations.meta_description: Descubra o píer de Riohacha, a praça de Padilla e o Valle de los Cangrejos. Conheça experiências em Camarones e excursões por La Guajira.

destination_story_translations.body: Riohacha creció como ciudad portuaria frente al Caribe, cerca de la desembocadura del Ranchería. Su centro conserva la plaza de Padilla y la catedral de Nuestra Señora de los Remedios.
Riohacha developed as a port city on the Caribbean, near the mouth of the Ranchería. Its centre retains Padilla Square and Nuestra Señora de los Remedios Cathedral.
Riohacha cresceu como cidade portuária diante do Caribe, perto da foz do Ranchería. Seu centro conserva a praça de Padilla e a Catedral de Nuestra Señora de los Remedios.
La presencia wayuu y las comunidades del litoral forman parte de su identidad. El frente costero y los ambientes de Camarones conectan la vida urbana con los paisajes de La Guajira.
Wayuu culture and coastal communities are part of its identity. The waterfront and the natural surroundings of Camarones link city life with the landscapes of La Guajira.
A presença wayuu e as comunidades do litoral fazem parte de sua identidade. A orla e os ambientes de Camarones ligam a vida urbana às paisagens de La Guajira.

destination_reason_translations.body: Conocer la cultura wayuu con anfitriones
Learn about Wayuu culture with local hosts
Conhecer a cultura wayuu com anfitriões

point_of_interest_translations.name: Malecón de Riohacha
point_of_interest_translations.description: El Paseo de la Marina recorre la playa urbana junto a la avenida Primera. Una caminata por el frente costero, distinta de la visita al muelle.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Riohacha waterfront promenade
point_of_interest_translations.description: Paseo de la Marina follows the urban beach beside Avenida Primera. A coastal walk, separate from visiting the pier.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Malecón de Riohacha
point_of_interest_translations.description: O Paseo de la Marina acompanha a praia urbana junto à avenida Primera. Um passeio pela orla, distinto da visita ao píer.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Muelle turístico de Riohacha
point_of_interest_translations.description: El muelle peatonal se adentra en el Caribe y ofrece una vista del frente costero de Riohacha.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Riohacha tourist pier
point_of_interest_translations.description: The pedestrian pier extends into the Caribbean and offers a view of Riohacha’s waterfront.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Píer turístico de Riohacha
point_of_interest_translations.description: O píer de pedestres avança pelo Caribe e oferece uma vista da orla de Riohacha.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Plaza Almirante Padilla
point_of_interest_translations.description: La plaza del centro histórico reúne el monumento al almirante y la catedral de Nuestra Señora de los Remedios.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Almirante Padilla Square
point_of_interest_translations.description: The historic centre’s main square brings together the admiral’s monument and Nuestra Señora de los Remedios Cathedral.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Praça Almirante Padilla
point_of_interest_translations.description: A praça do centro histórico reúne o monumento ao almirante e a Catedral de Nuestra Señora de los Remedios.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Valle de los Cangrejos
point_of_interest_translations.description: Manglares y costa se encuentran en este sector del delta del Ranchería, al noreste de la ciudad.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Valle de los Cangrejos
point_of_interest_translations.description: Mangroves meet the coast in this part of the Ranchería delta, northeast of the city.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Valle de los Cangrejos
point_of_interest_translations.description: Manguezais e litoral se encontram neste setor do delta do Ranchería, a nordeste da cidade.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Catedral Nuestra Señora de los Remedios
point_of_interest_translations.description: El templo que enmarca la Plaza Padilla es uno de los referentes patrimoniales de Riohacha. Una visita distinta al monumento de la plaza, respetando las celebraciones religiosas.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Our Lady of Remedies Cathedral
point_of_interest_translations.description: The cathedral overlooking Plaza Padilla is a heritage landmark of Riohacha. Visit the church separately from the square’s monument, respecting religious services.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Catedral Nossa Senhora dos Remédios
point_of_interest_translations.description: O templo junto à Praça Padilla é uma referência patrimonial de Riohacha. A visita à igreja é distinta do monumento da praça e deve respeitar as celebrações religiosas.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parque Nicolás de Federman
point_of_interest_translations.description: Una plaza del frente costero vinculada a la memoria de la ciudad, con el monumento a Federman y las mariposas amarillas. Complementa el paseo por la avenida de la Marina.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Nicolás de Federman Park
point_of_interest_translations.description: A waterfront square linked to the city’s history, with the Federman monument and yellow butterflies sculpture. It complements a walk along Avenida de la Marina.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parque Nicolás de Federman
point_of_interest_translations.description: Uma praça da orla ligada à memória da cidade, com o monumento a Federman e a escultura das borboletas amarelas. Complementa o passeio pela avenida da Marina.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Santuario de Flora y Fauna Los Flamencos
point_of_interest_translations.description: En Camarones, dentro del municipio de Riohacha, este santuario protege lagunas costeras y hábitats de aves. La entrada se coordina con intérprete o guía local; el recorrido de avistamiento aparece en experiencias.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Los Flamencos Flora and Fauna Sanctuary
point_of_interest_translations.description: In Camarones, within Riohacha municipality, this sanctuary protects coastal lagoons and bird habitats. Entry requires coordination with a local guide or interpreter; the guided birdwatching outing appears under experiences.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Santuário de Flora e Fauna Los Flamencos
point_of_interest_translations.description: Em Camarones, no município de Riohacha, o santuário protege lagoas costeiras e habitats de aves. A entrada deve ser coordenada com guia ou intérprete local; o passeio de observação está em experiências.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Playas de Mayapo (alrededores)
point_of_interest_translations.description: Playas del municipio vecino de Manaure, para conocer desde Riohacha. Arena clara y paisaje costero guajiro; confirma el acceso al sector que elijas y las condiciones del mar.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Mayapo beaches (nearby)
point_of_interest_translations.description: Beaches in neighbouring Manaure municipality, reachable from Riohacha. Pale sand and La Guajira coastal scenery; check access to your chosen beach sector and sea conditions.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Praias de Mayapo (arredores)
point_of_interest_translations.description: Praias do município vizinho de Manaure, para conhecer a partir de Riohacha. Areia clara e paisagem costeira guajira; confirme o acesso ao trecho escolhido e as condições do mar.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Avistamiento de flamencos en Camarones
point_of_interest_translations.description: Recorrido acompañado por el entorno lagunar del santuario Los Flamencos para observar aves sin alterar su hábitat.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Flamingo watching in Camarones
point_of_interest_translations.description: Explore the lagoon surroundings of Los Flamencos sanctuary with a guide, observing birds without disturbing their habitat.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Observação de flamingos em Camarones
point_of_interest_translations.description: Percorra o ambiente lagunar do santuário Los Flamencos com acompanhamento, observando aves sem perturbar seu habitat.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Encuentro cultural wayuu
point_of_interest_translations.description: Una visita organizada y acordada con anfitriones para acercarse a las artesanías y tradiciones del pueblo wayuu.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Wayuu cultural encounter
point_of_interest_translations.description: An organised visit arranged with local hosts to learn about Wayuu crafts and traditions.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Encontro cultural wayuu
point_of_interest_translations.description: Uma visita organizada e combinada com anfitriões para conhecer o artesanato e as tradições do povo wayuu.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Excursión a la Alta Guajira (alrededores)
point_of_interest_translations.description: Desde Riohacha salen recorridos de varios días hacia el Cabo de la Vela y Punta Gallinas, en el municipio de Uribia.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Alta Guajira excursion (surrounding region)
point_of_interest_translations.description: Multi-day trips depart from Riohacha for Cabo de la Vela and Punta Gallinas, in the municipality of Uribia.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Excursão à Alta Guajira (arredores)
point_of_interest_translations.description: De Riohacha saem roteiros de vários dias para Cabo de la Vela e Punta Gallinas, no município de Uribia.
